title: Not sure if this really fits here so apologies if I’m a lost redditor.
content: Alright so I have a few malls that recur. 1. This giant like mega mall that the only near by things are a highway, a larger hotel, a Walmart, and a gas station. Other than that it’s completely empty and it’s a very large stretch. I’ve never managed to go into this mall. I always see this for maybe a few minutes from an aerial view or very rarely passing by as a passenger in a car. I’m always a kid if I’m in the car despite being a 30 year old irl. 2. This mall shifts a little but ultimately follows this layout. A food court the size of an average mall with almost any restaurant I can think of. It’s always slightly elevated from the rest of the floor. There is always a large set of like coin operated machines downstairs that dispense little things along with those stands of toys and stuff that get setup near holidays. I always seem to find myself lost here and almost always far away from home knowing I need to leave soon so I can get home. I always seem to become aware of roughly how much money I have left IRL in these scenarios. If I’m doing well I buy things and if I’m not I’m struggling to just leave 3. The half dead mall. Half the stores are closed. Nothing but knockoff shops that have survived. Always has like 2 or 3 entrances on the dead sides and only one on the alive side. Most of these happen before I wake up for the day to my knowledge.
